business_summary: Sanoyas Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and assembly of machinery and parts in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Manufacturing, Construction, and Leisure segments. The Manufacturing segment manufactures, assembles, and maintains shot blast machines, parts for various industrial machinery, agricultural machinery, and specially equipped automobiles, emulsifying and stirring equipment, and designs and constructs pure water equipment, wastewater treatment equipment, membrane separation equipment, and tanks, such as large food tanks. The Construction segment manufactures and maintains mechanical parking equipment, and electrical machinery and electrical work; manufactures and rents elevators for construction work; and designs and installs air-conditioning, water supply and drainage, manufacturing and maintenance of environmental sanitation equipment, and manufacturing of medical waste treatment equipment. The Leisure segment manufactures amusement park machines and equipment; and operates and manages amusement parks. Sanoyas Holdings Corporation was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
